Subject: Security exhibit redline sprint & SOC 2 / pen test evidence cadence

Hi Simon / Atlas procurement team —

Thanks for sending the MSA + order form draft last week. We reviewed the security exhibit and pulled together a short redline plan so we can close the outstanding audit/evidence items without blocking signature. High-level ask: can we align on a 48-hour redline turnaround window for the exhibit and a scheduled evidence handoff cadence for SOC 2 artifacts and the pen test scope?

What we propose:
- This week: legal redline pass (attached: security_exhibit_v2_redlines.docx) — Laura will lead.
- Next week: pen test scope finalization (attached: pen_test_scope_v1.xlsx) so Atlas can schedule the external test window.
- SOC 2 evidence: we can provide the 2026 report and a scoped evidence package on a rolling cadence (see attachment SOC2-report-2026.pdf).

Open questions:
1) Does Atlas require onsite witness access for the pen test or is remote evidence sufficient?
2) Any procurement deadlines or signature windows we should be aware of?

Laura / Karthik / Marcus — tagging you for redline ownership and any legal/compliance flags. Simon / procurement — if you prefer a short sync to walk the redlines, happy to book 30 mins.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Head of Sales, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Olga —

Thanks for the plan and the attachments. Procurement is comfortable with a quick redline sprint; our CISO team wants clarity on the pen test scope and evidence handoff timing before we proceed to countersign. A couple quick notes:

- We prefer remote evidence for SOC 2 evidence collection, but the pen test vendor has an option for limited onsite observation (we'll confirm).
- Procurement deadline: we need fully executed docs by 2027-05-03 to hit our internal Q2 budget window.

I copied CISO Support (ciso-support@atlashealth.com) — can your security/compliance lead share the evidence package outline and confirm what will be included in the SOC 2 evidence bundle?

Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Security exhibit redline sprint & SOC 2 / pen test evidence cadence

Simon / Atlas team —

Appreciate the timeline callout. Quick overview of our position after the first pass:

1) Audit rights / pen test language — we are proposing scoped, mutually agreed windows and vendor rules of engagement rather than open-ended rights. In the redline doc I’ve preserved the concept of audit rights but added: (a) notice periods, (b) mutually agreed scope, and (c) data access controls.
2) Evidence cadence — we'll provide the SOC 2 report and a prioritized evidence bundle (mapped to Atlas control requests) within 5 business days of countersignature, then a follow-up sync to fill gaps. For any live system artifacts (logs, config), we will provide time-bound read-only access or extracted evidence exports.
3) Pen test scope — please review the attached pen_test_scope_v1.xlsx; it includes a preferred test window recommendation and excluded systems. If Atlas requires additional scope, that will impact scheduling and cost.

Action items:
- Simon / procurement: confirm the Q2 budget window and whether 2027-05-03 is fixed.
- Atlas CISO: please confirm if remote evidence + scheduled vendor communications is acceptable.
- Marcus: can you prepare a short evidence inventory that maps SOC 2 assertions to typical artifacts? I can use that to respond to their control list.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0234

Attachment: security_exhibit_v2_redlines.docx, pen_test_scope_v1.xlsx

From: CISO Support <ciso-support@atlashealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Simon Patel <simon.patel@atlashealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit redline sprint & SOC 2 / pen test evidence cadence

Laura —

Thanks for the clarifications. Remote evidence is fine provided we have: (1) a list of exact artifacts and retention windows, (2) an agreed exporter format (CSV / PDF), and (3) a named point of contact for evidence access. On pen tests: we request the vendor output to include telemetry captures and a remediation tracking spreadsheet. We can accept a 2-week scheduling window for vendor availability.

We also request that the redline include a clause confirming Redwood will retain audit logs for a minimum of 12 months for Atlas-scoped events. Is that something you can confirm?

Regards,
CISO Support Team
Atlas Health
ciso-support@atlashealth.com
